name: crust-agent
description: Crust - Emo Pizza Ordering Agent for Microsoft Foundry

scripts.lint: npm run lint:yaml && npm run lint:json && npm run lint:ts
scripts.lint:json: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); let failed=false; const skip=new Set(['node_modules','.git','playwright-report']); const walk=(dir)=>{ for(const name of fs.readdirSync(dir)){ if(skip.has(name)) continue; const p=path.join(dir,name); const s=fs.statSync(p); if(s.isDirectory()) walk(p); else if(name.endsWith('.json')){ try{ JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')); } catch(e){ failed=true; console.error('Invalid JSON:', p); console.error(e.message);} } } }; walk('.'); if(failed) process.exit(1); console.log('JSON lint passed');"
